completion_promises.criterion_text: Module imports successfully when `graphiti-core` is uninstalled (verified by integration test that runs in a venv without graphiti-core)
completion_promises.evidence: graphiti_core import lives only inside _load_graphiti_core() (function body) — no top-level import. test_module_top_level_has_no_graphiti_core_import scans the source and fails on any top-level graphiti import. test_module_loads_in_subprocess_with_graphiti_core_absent launches a fresh python -c subprocess that pre-sets sys.modules['graphiti_core']=None (which causes any subsequent `import graphiti_core` to raise ImportError) and confirms study_tutor.knowledge.graphiti_client still imports cleanly and GraphitiConnectionConfig is constructible. Both pass on turn 3 (23/23 in test_graphiti_client.py). Coach turn 2 verified.

completion_promises.criterion_text: `get_client()` returns `None` (not raises) when graphiti-core is absent, FalkorDB is unreachable, or healthcheck times out
completion_promises.evidence: get_client() implements three documented degradation gates: (1) ImportError from _load_graphiti_core → log + return None; (2) any exception from FalkorDriver(...) or Graphiti(...) construction → log + return None; (3) healthcheck() returning False (timeout or driver exception) → log + close partial wrapper + return None. No exception escapes. Verified by test_get_client_returns_none_when_graphiti_core_import_fails, test_get_client_returns_none_when_driver_construction_fails, and test_get_client_returns_none_when_healthcheck_times_out — all green on turn 3. Coach turn 2 verified.

completion_promises.criterion_text: `GraphitiConnectionConfig` rejects invalid values (negative port, non-positive timeout)
completion_promises.evidence: GraphitiConnectionConfig uses pydantic Field constraints: falkor_port=Field(gt=0), timeout_seconds=Field(default=5.0, gt=0). model_config=ConfigDict(extra='forbid'). Verified by test_config_rejects_negative_port, test_config_rejects_zero_port, test_config_rejects_zero_timeout, test_config_rejects_negative_timeout, test_config_rejects_extra_fields — all green on turn 3. Coach turn 2 verified.

GraphitiClient.healthcheck wraps the inner _ping() in asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=self._config.timeout_seconds). Default timeout_seconds=5.0 matches ASSUM-005. Verified by test_config_default_timeout_matches_assum_005, test_healthcheck_respects_short_timeout (slow driver 0.5s + timeout=0.05s returns False well under 0.3s), test_get_client_returns_none_when_healthcheck_times_out — all green on turn 3. Coach turn 2 verified.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Structured log line on every degradation path: `event=graphiti_client_degraded` with `error_class`, `falkor_host`, `degraded=true`

completion_promises.criterion_text: `close()` is idempotent and safe to call when client is None
completion_promises.evidence: GraphitiClient.close() short-circuits when self._inner is None. On the first real close it captures the inner reference, sets self._inner = None *before* awaiting (re-entrancy / concurrent-close safety), then calls inner.close() inside try/except so a raising shutdown cannot propagate. Verified by test_close_is_safe_when_inner_is_none, test_close_calls_inner_close_exactly_once_then_zeros_state, test_close_swallows_inner_close_exceptions — all green on turn 3. Coach turn 2 verified.
